parsed.why: No trans-specific offence or criminalisation; police escort Pride and LGBTI group operates freely nationwide. But no protections, documented societal stigma and undated assaults, and unresolved document-mismatch charge risk. Thin recourse holds it below acceptance-with-protections.

Hate-speech and anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, working hate-crime framework, liberal society, prosecutions to maximum. Offset by rising reported hate crimes, falling clearance, low police trust. No documented visitor-facing restriction.

Universal border/document regime: sex-assigned markers, X withdrawn, refusals and detentions of foreigners, allied travel advisories, visa fraud ineligibility. Facilities bans criminal in four states, birth-sex custody abuse. State threat-framing.

Cross-dressing ban struck down 2022, but morality laws strictly enforced, sodomy prosecutions documented as police lever, official discrimination against trans people persists, dress-code policing remains, no recourse or association.

No criminalisation, strong trans legal history, marriage recognition. But recent deterioration: care-ban decree (struck down), prison-housing decree, anti-discrimination agency abolished, record hate crimes, activists report heightened vulnerability.
